mapper.select: select * from psy_student_profile where user_id = #{userId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into psy_student_profile (user_id, student_no, real_name, college, major, class_name, contact_phone, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{userId}, #{studentNo}, #{realName}, #{college}, #{major}, #{className}, #{contactPhone}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.select: select * from psy_counselor_profile where user_id = #{userId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into psy_counselor_profile (user_id, counselor_no, real_name, title, specialty, introduction, available_status, contact_phone, service_score, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{userId}, #{counselorNo}, #{realName}, #{title}, #{specialty}, #{introduction}, #{availableStatus}, #{contactPhone}, #{serviceScore}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.select: select coalesce((select risk_level from psy_emotion_record where student_user_id = #{userId} order by create_time desc limit 1), '正常') as latestRiskLevel, coalesce((select count(1) from psy_assessment_record where student_user_id = #{userId}), 0) as recentAssessmentCount, coalesce((select count(1) from psy_appointment where student_user_id = #{userId} and status in ('待确认', '已确认')), 0) as pendingAppointmentCount
select * from psy_emotion_record where student_user_id = #{userId} order by create_time desc limit 1
select * from psy_emotion_record where student_user_id = #{userId} order by create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into psy_emotion_record (student_user_id, anonymous_flag, original_text, processed_text, primary_emotion, emotion_tags, confidence, risk_level, emotion_score, analysis_summary, guidance_advice, warning_flag, create_by, create_time) values (#{studentUserId}, #{anonymousFlag}, #{originalText}, #{processedText}, #{primaryEmotion}, #{emotionTags}, #{confidence}, #{riskLevel}, #{emotionScore}, #{analysisSummary}, #{guidanceAdvice}, #{warningFlag}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select * from psy_scale where scale_id = #{scaleId}
select * from psy_scale_question where scale_id = #{scaleId} order by question_sort asc
select * from psy_scale_option where question_id = #{questionId} order by option_sort asc
mapper.insert: insert into psy_assessment_record (student_user_id, scale_id, scale_name, total_score, result_level, result_summary, guidance_advice, warning_flag, create_by, create_time) values (#{studentUserId}, #{scaleId}, #{scaleName}, #{totalScore}, #{resultLevel}, #{resultSummary}, #{guidanceAdvice}, #{warningFlag}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
insert into psy_assessment_answer (record_id, question_id, option_id, option_score) values (#{recordId}, #{questionId}, #{optionId}, #{optionScore})
mapper.select: select * from psy_assessment_record where student_user_id = #{userId} order by create_time desc
select * from psy_counselor_profile where available_status = '0' order by service_score desc, counselor_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into psy_appointment (student_user_id, counselor_user_id, appointment_time, topic, problem_description, status, create_by, create_time) values (#{studentUserId}, #{counselorUserId}, #{appointmentTime}, #{topic}, #{problemDescription}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select a.*, c.real_name as counselor_name, c.title as counselor_title from psy_appointment a left join psy_counselor_profile c on a.counselor_user_id = c.user_id where a.student_user_id = #{userId} order by a.create_time desc

select a.*, c.real_name as counselor_name, c.title as counselor_title from psy_appointment a left join psy_counselor_profile c on a.counselor_user_id = c.user_id where a.counselor_user_id = #{userId} order by a.create_time desc
mapper.update: update psy_appointment set status = #{status}, review_note = #{reviewNote}, counseling_summary = #{counselingSummary}, update_time = sysdate() where appointment_id = #{appointmentId} and counselor_user_id = #{counselorUserId}
mapper.select: select count(1) from psy_message where receiver_user_id = #{userId} and read_status = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into psy_message (receiver_user_id, message_type, title, content, read_status, create_by, create_time) values (#{receiverUserId}, #{messageType}, #{title}, #{content}, #{readStatus}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select coalesce((select count(1) from psy_appointment where counselor_user_id = #{userId} and date(appointment_time) = curdate()), 0) as todayAppointmentCount, coalesce((select count(1) from psy_appointment where counselor_user_id = #{userId} and status = '待确认'), 0) as pendingAppointmentCount, coalesce((select count(1) from psy_warning where counselor_user_id = #{userId} and risk_level = '高风险' and status in ('待处理', '处理中')), 0) as highRiskWarningCount, coalesce((select count(1) from psy_appointment where counselor_user_id = #{userId} and status = '已完成' and yearweek(appointment_time, 1) = yearweek(curdate(), 1)), 0) as weekCounselingCount

select w.*, sp.real_name as student_name, cp.real_name as counselor_name from psy_warning w left join psy_student_profile sp on w.student_user_id = sp.user_id left join psy_counselor_profile cp on w.counselor_user_id = cp.user_id where w.warning_id = #{warningId}
mapper.insert: insert into psy_warning (warning_no, student_user_id, warning_source, source_record_id, risk_level, status, counselor_user_id, trigger_summary, process_note, follow_plan, create_by, create_time) values (#{warningNo}, #{studentUserId}, #{warningSource}, #{sourceRecordId}, #{riskLevel}, #{status}, #{counselorUserId}, #{triggerSummary}, #{processNote}, #{followPlan}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select user_id from psy_counselor_profile where available_status = '0' order by service_score desc, counselor_id asc limit 1
